description: Proposed works to both first and second floor flats: Replacement of existing windows with matching slimline conservation grade double-glazed timber sash windows; general internal alterations throughout. Proposed works to second floor flat only include: Roof alterations to mirror the outline and levels to mirror 7 Wetherby Gardens and bring symmetry; replacement dormers to be identical to each other; transform existing mezzanine loft floor into living accommodation floor with a study and a roof terrace by mirroring the overall arrangement of 7 Wetherby Gardens; new thermally efficient rooflights to roof; and green hedge planting to roof terrace perimeter, to provide acoustic screening and encourage biodiversity
site_name: First Floor Flat and Second/third Floor Flat, 6 Wetherby Gardens, LONDON, SW5 0JN
